This 2001 Am General Hummer Hard Top is presented as a full-size utility vehicle with the familiar squared-off bodywork and substantial stance associated with the model. Its hard top gives the cabin a closed, finished profile, and the body retains the upright glass, broad fender surfaces, and heavy-duty appearance that defined the line. The exterior design is functional in its proportions, with short overhangs and a high profile that reflect the vehicle's original purpose. Panel fit, openings, and major exterior elements are arranged in a straightforward manner, with little emphasis on ornamentation.

This Am General Hummer uses an automatic transmission, and the driveline is built around the sort of hardware expected in a vehicle of this type. The chassis is designed for demanding use, and the underlying structure is substantial. Ground clearance, approach angles, and the general underbody packaging follow the original Hummer approach to off-pavement capability, with components placed to support durability and clearance. The body-on-frame construction and broad track contribute to the vehicle's planted feel, while the size and weight of the platform are evident in its stance and proportions. Mechanical access points, tow-related hardware, and other working details are integrated into the design without excess trim.

This Hummer includes Automatic Climate Control, Rear A/C, and Keyless Entry. The cabin follows a utilitarian theme, with controls and switches laid out for direct use. Seating surfaces, trim materials, and interior panels are arranged in a practical manner, and the hard top helps create an enclosed environment with a more finished feel than an open-body version. The rear seating area is part of the interior package and benefits from the added air conditioning provision. Instrumentation and driver controls are positioned to remain visible and accessible, and the overall presentation is consistent with a vehicle built to prioritize function over decoration.

This 2001 Am General Hummer Hard Top carries the familiar large grille opening, exposed external details, and broad fender arches that are closely associated with the nameplate. The vehicle's dimensions are substantial, and the hood, windshield, and roofline follow the upright proportions of the original design. Doors, mirrors, and lighting elements are presented in a simple and durable style, and the exterior surfaces are mostly flat and unadorned. The hard top preserves the enclosed profile while keeping the body's utilitarian character intact, and the available equipment supports the vehicle's use as a heavy-duty passenger and utility machine.

Its boxy proportions, upright greenhouse, broad fenders, removable-style rear roof design, and unmistakable Ford identity give it a look that has aged exceptionally well. Add the lift, black wheels, and contrasting lower body and this Bronco takes that classic formula to another level.

The spacious cabin gives you plenty of room for passengers and gear, while the high seating position provides the excellent visibility that has always been part of the full-size Bronco experience. The combination of leather seating, classic Ford instrumentation, large steering wheel, and period-correct controls gives the interior an unmistakable 1990s Ford character.

For drivers seeking a versatile compact SUV with premium features and low mileage, this pre-owned 2018 Honda HR-V EX-L Navi is an excellent choice. Powered by a 4-cylinder, 1.8L gasoline engine, it delivers smooth performance and responsive handling ideal for city streets and open roads. Inside, the EX-L Navi trim brings a refined cabin designed for comfort and convenience. Enjoy leather seats that add a premium touch, along with automatic climate control for a pleasant drive in every season. The built-in navigation system helps you stay on course, while the back-up camera makes parking and reversing easier. Hands free Bluetooth connectivity allows you to make calls and stream audio with added convenience and less distraction. This 2018 Honda HR-V EX-L Navi combines practicality, comfort, and thoughtful technology in a stylish package. Located in Yakima, WA, it is a great option for shoppers looking for a dependable pre-owned SUV with desirable features and low mileage. Contact us today to learn more or schedule a test drive.

*Equipment*
You'll never again be lost in a crowded city or a country region with the navigation system on this Honda HR-V. This 2018 Honda HR-V features a hands-free Bluetooth phone system. Protect this Honda HR-V from unwanted accidents with a cutting edge backup camera system. The leather seats in this Honda HR-V are a must for buyers looking for comfort, durability, and style. The Honda HR-V keeps you comfortable with Auto Climate. Maintaining a stable interior temperature in this small suv is easy with the climate control system. Conquer any rainy, snowy, or icy road conditions this winter with the all wheel drive system on this unit. This vehicle shines with clean polished lines coated with an elegant white finish. This vehicle has a 4 Cyl, 1.8L high output engine. It has fog lights for all weather conditions. This model features cruise control for long trips. It has an automatic transmission.
